### How to use it

Set your SMTP credentials as environment variables and run:

```bash
SMTP_HOST=smtp.gmail.com \
SMTP_PORT=587 \
SMTP_USER=you@gmail.com \
SMTP_PASS=your-app-password \
FROM_EMAIL=you@gmail.com \
node send_order_summary.js
```

### What it does
- Sends a nicely formatted **HTML email** to `bob@example.com` with the full order summary (tables, metrics, top products, and notes).
- Supports any SMTP provider (Gmail, Outlook, SendGrid, etc.).
- For **Gmail**, you'll need an [App Password](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/185833) rather than your regular password.
- Set `SMTP_SECURE=true` if your provider uses port 465 (implicit TLS).
